title: Project Manager Resume Examples & Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Top Project Manager resume examples and ATS guide. Copy premium LaTeX template code, discover agile leadership skills, and write results-driven bullet points.

summaryExamples.title: Junior Project Manager
summaryExamples.text: Energetic Associate Project Manager with solid experience coordinating agile software sprints, cross-functional scheduling, and budget tracking. Certified Scrum Master (CSM) skilled in Jira, Confluence, and stakeholder relations. Dedicated to finishing complex tech projects on time and within scope.

summaryExamples.title: Mid Level Project Manager
summaryExamples.text: Project Manager with 6+ years of experience leading complex IT and software product delivery cycles. Expert in Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies. Proven track record of managing $1M+ budgets and improving sprint planning velocities by 20% across multiple teams.

summaryExamples.title: Senior Project Manager
summaryExamples.text: Senior Project Director / PMP with 12+ years of experience leading global tech operations, portfolio management, and system integrations. Master at coordinating cross-functional engineering teams, scope definition, and business risk audits. Managed budgets exceeding $5M with a history of on-time delivery.

points: Coordinated agile development lifecycles for 3 cross-functional engineering teams, delivering a core mobile app release 2 weeks ahead of target launch date.
Facilitated daily standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives, boosting development team velocity by 18% over two quarters.
Managed resource allocation and project scope definitions for a $1.2M web design project, maintaining a 98% budget accuracy rate.
Identified and mitigated major project blockages early, reducing typical sprint delays by 30% through improved Jira workflow boards.
Acted as primary liaison between executive leadership and 15 developers, keeping product delivery goals transparent and updates clear.
Negotiated third-party integrations and contracts, reducing software licensing overhead expenses by 15%.
Orchestrated client onboarding presentations and workshops, increasing customer onboarding satisfaction scores by 25%.

faqs.question: What certifications stand out on a Project Manager resume?
faqs.answer: PMP (Project Management Professional) and CSM (Certified Scrum Master) are the gold standards. Listing these clearly in your resume header or skills section significantly increases recruiter calls.

faqs.question: How do you show agile leadership on a resume?
faqs.answer: Describe your team size, meeting frequency, and improvements in productivity. Write about how you ran sprint plans, tracked sprint velocities, and resolved blocking tasks to keep deliverables on schedule.
